Title: Dr Debas and Dr Tibaijuka appointed to AKU Board of Trustees
NewsSummary: Aga Khan University is pleased to welcome Dr Haile T. Debas and Dr Anna Kajumulo Tibaijuka as Trustees from January 2010. They bring with them a wealth of international experience in the fields of education, medicine and development.
NewsContent:
"Aga Khan University is pleased to welcome Dr Haile T. Debas and Dr Anna Kajumulo Tibaijuka as Trustees from January 2010. They bring with them a wealth of international experience in the fields of education, medicine and development.

Dr Debasis the Executive Director of Global Health Sciences at the University of California, San Francisco. He has had a distinguished four-decade career as a physician, researcher and academic at medical and educational centres across North America. Dr Debas is a fellow of the Royal College of Physicians and Surgeons of Canada and the American Academy of Arts and Sciences. He is also a member of several leading professional associations and his work has been recognised by institutions including McGill University and the American Association of Medical Colleges.

Dr Tibaijuka is a leading expert in global development and urbanisation issues. The first African woman elected by the United Nations General Assembly as Under-Secretary-General of a UN programme, she is now serving a second term as the Executive Director of UN-HABITAT. Dr Tibaijuka is also a member of social development commissions run by the World Health Organization and UNDP, and served as a UN Special Envoy to Zimbabwe in2005. Prior to joining the UN, Dr Tibaijuka pursued an active academic career as a professor of economics at the University of Dar es Salaam, Tanzania. In November, 2009, she was awarded the prestigious Göteborg Award for Sustainable Development."​
